status: Gate GSP03 (SP03 playback history off the response path), registered before any measured run, after the wiring smoke. Derived from drafts/gsp03-draft.json; the draft's open choices are settled as proposed (decision_rule.registration_choices); image, source and hashes filled in.
item: SP03: playback history once per playback, off the response path. C0 = PLAYBACK_HISTORY_BACKGROUND=false (today's path: every GET/HEAD awaits the locked, threaded get_or_create before its headers); C3 = PLAYBACK_HISTORY_BACKGROUND=true (996abd6 candidate: repeated requests skip the DB, the first write is an owned background task, 64 pending max with a synchronous fallback, a failed write is retried by the next request). Same image, the arms differ only by this env value.

Ruff (server/pyproject.toml config) on every changed or new script

C0.role: baseline (today's behaviour, also the code default)

scenario.warm_torrent: per run, playback token 0 reads the whole 256 MiB file (Range bytes=0-) before the series, so every piece is downloaded; not a sample. The DB load (dbload cells) already runs during the warm-up.
scenario.series: after 2 s settle, a fresh playback token 1 (a new playback_id, so request 1 is the history INSERT in C0 and the background write in C3) sends 20 sequential bounded Range GETs of 1 MiB, 200 ms apart: request 1 at 0, request 2 the tail probe, then 18 golden-ratio spread 64 KiB-aligned offsets (the same in every run). Every stream response is Connection: close, so each request opens a new TCP+TLS connection through the proxy, as a player sees it.
scenario.ttfb: per request, from the request start (connection setup included) to the first body byte; per run p50 (median) and p95 (nearest rank) over the 20 requests, plus request 1 alone and the repeats 2..20.
scenario.rtt: H3 latency_proxy.py between client and app in every cell: one-way 0.5 ms (RTT 1 ms) or 10 ms (RTT 20 ms).
scenario.db_write_load: dbload cells: sp_db_write_load.py in the app container for the whole client run: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, 256 KiB random blob insert, write lock held 20 ms, COMMIT, 20 ms pause (about 50 % write-lock duty), at most 64 scratch rows kept.
scenario.lost_writes: after the client (and the load stop), sp_history_check.py polls up to 10 s for a playback_histories row of both playback ids of the run: lost_writes = 2 - found.

expected_mechanism.repeats: C0 pays a thread hop, the per-playback lock, an isolated SQLite session and a joined SELECT (get_or_create read) before every response's headers; C3 skips the DB after the first write -> a small per-request gain in every cell, best visible at RTT 1 ms.
expected_mechanism.first_request: C0 inserts and commits inline; under the parallel write load it waits for the SQLite write lock (busy handler) -> the larger gain is in series.first_ttfb_s of the dbload cells, a single value per run (guard and descriptive, not the primary metric). WAL readers do not wait for the writer, so the repeats are affected by the load mainly through CPU.
expected_mechanism.rtt20: connection setup through the proxy (TCP + TLS + request, about 3 RTT) dominates; the same absolute gain is a smaller share and may stay within the noise.

wiring_smoke.note: Not a measurement: this image, the plan with series [{C0, C3} x 1], 8 runs (2 arms x 4 cells); the draft's smoke checks all hold (asserted at registration).

decision_rule.primary_metric: series.ttfb_s_p50 (per-run median TTFB of the 20 Range requests, seconds)
decision_rule.pooling: both series pooled: n = 10 runs per arm and cell; failed runs excluded and counted
decision_rule.statistic: difference of means (C3 - C0); 10 000 bootstrap resamples per test, seed 20261112; one-sided bootstrap p-values
decision_rule.improvement: primary metric in a key cell: H0 'difference >= 0' rejected by Holm over the 4 key cells
decision_rule.regression: any guard test (series.ttfb_s_p50, series.ttfb_s_p95, series.first_ttfb_s in all 4 cells, 12 tests): H0 'difference <= 0' rejected by Holm over the 12 tests
pass_if_all: at least 2 of 4 key cells improved
C3: lost_writes = 0, non-206 responses = 0 and client errors = 0 in every non-failed run (none missing)
failed runs and tracebacks with an application frame: C3 <= C0
descriptive_only: C0 lost writes, non-206 and errors (reported, not a C3 criterion)
db_write_load transactions, lock duty and errors (both arms)
warm-up seconds, app CPU and memory
decision_rule.otherwise: FAIL: playback_history_background stays False (the SP03 code stays switched off; removing it is a separate package).

registration_choices.improved_required: 2 of 4 key cells, the draft proposal (accepted).
registration_choices.primary_metric: series.ttfb_s_p50 with p95 and first TTFB as guards, the draft proposal (accepted).
registration_choices.db_load_strength: The draft's 256 KiB / 20 ms hold / 20 ms pause, unchanged: the wiring smoke shows lock duty within 0.3..0.7 and 0 errors in both dbload cells (wiring_smoke).

infra_retry: The controller reruns a run once when it failed by Docker itself (docker run exit 125, 'error waiting for container', 'error during connect', 'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon'); the record keeps the first failure as infra_retry. Any other failure, or a second infrastructure failure, stays a failed run and counts under 'failed runs C3 <= C0'.

runner.where: host shell in the SP03 worktree, local Docker Desktop, sequential with every other measurement (no build or other gate while it runs).
runner.runs_and_time: 2 series x 5 reps x 4 cells x 2 arms = 80 runs, each with fresh network, volume and containers; about 1 min per run (start, warm-up ~10 s, series ~5 s, teardown) -> about 1.5 h; label order rotates per repetition, the two arms of a cell run back to back.
